title: PPIA-15 Expanded Nonduplicate Regression Scenario Library
provenance_class: P15-PV-003 synthetic-awkward-expansion except explicit P15-PV-004 source-gap guard

scenario_contracts.title: Concurrent same-object intent
scenario_contracts.material_differential: two authorized actors act before observing the competing intent
scenario_contracts.expected_authoritative_outcome: one owning-domain accepted result or explicit conflict; never duplicate mutation

scenario_contracts.title: Concurrent duplicate-name targeting
scenario_contracts.material_differential: concurrent intents target same-name visible objects with distinct stable IDs
scenario_contracts.expected_authoritative_outcome: each intent remains bound to its exact authorized stable ID

scenario_contracts.title: Live mid-session clue reveal
scenario_contracts.material_differential: reveal changes after recipient and GM projections are already open
scenario_contracts.expected_authoritative_outcome: reveal remains owned by PPIA-09 and recipient receives only currently authorized clue state

scenario_contracts.title: Mid-flow entitlement revocation
scenario_contracts.material_differential: permission becomes invalid while protected projection/actions are cached
scenario_contracts.expected_authoritative_outcome: no unauthorized mutation; protected derivatives and actions are invalidated before reuse

scenario_contracts.title: GM modification from stale proposal
scenario_contracts.material_differential: baseline GM modification is composed with stale proposal version rather than cloned
scenario_contracts.expected_authoritative_outcome: stale request cannot overwrite current proposal; current version and authorized intents remain reviewable

scenario_contracts.title: Stable identity under duplicate display names
scenario_contracts.material_differential: three authorized objects share display text and one safe disambiguator later disappears
scenario_contracts.expected_authoritative_outcome: stable target identity remains correct after projection loses a disambiguating field

scenario_contracts.title: Two-editor expected-version conflict
scenario_contracts.material_differential: two editors preserve both authorized intents after one version advances
scenario_contracts.expected_authoritative_outcome: one accepted change may advance version; stale intent is rejected or explicitly reviewed

scenario_contracts.title: Campaign-local override versus inherited update
scenario_contracts.material_differential: inherited Definition changes after a Campaign-local override exists
scenario_contracts.operation: inspect/reconcile local override with inherited current version
scenario_contracts.expected_authoritative_outcome: local override remains Campaign-local and attributable; no silent promotion or discard

scenario_contracts.title: Source-only Definition inspection
nearest_inherited_anchors: PPIA-05 Species/Form Definition versus current form
scenario_contracts.material_differential: reusable source Definition is browsed without owned/Campaign/live instance
scenario_contracts.expected_authoritative_outcome: zero instance/ownership/Campaign/live mutation from inspection

scenario_contracts.title: Vehicle ownership transfer preserves relation separation
scenario_contracts.material_differential: ownership transfer occurs while custody/control/crew/passenger/cargo relations differ
scenario_contracts.expected_authoritative_outcome: only explicitly governed relation changes; unrelated relations remain authoritative and distinct

scenario_contracts.title: Bounded relationship-secret reveal
scenario_contracts.material_differential: one bounded audience receives a relationship secret while live nonrecipients remain nonleaking
scenario_contracts.expected_authoritative_outcome: recipient receives authorized secret projection; nonrecipients remain externally equivalent to no-secret state

scenario_contracts.title: Crafting interruption before submission
scenario_contracts.material_differential: construction is interrupted while still local draft state
scenario_contracts.expected_authoritative_outcome: no authoritative Event, approval, cost or completion is created

scenario_contracts.title: Crafting interruption after tracked submission
scenario_contracts.material_differential: submission may be durable while approval response is lost
scenario_contracts.operation: lookup tracked operation before any retry
scenario_contracts.expected_authoritative_outcome: current authoritative operation/approval state is resolved without duplicate costs or Events

scenario_contracts.title: Reconnect after approval acceptance before projection
scenario_contracts.material_differential: approval/reveal Event is accepted while requester/recipient is disconnected and projection lags
scenario_contracts.expected_authoritative_outcome: accepted result stays accepted; projection lag is not failure
forbidden_outcomes: failure classification caused only by projection lag

scenario_contracts.title: 512-record inventory identity and filtering
scenario_contracts.material_differential: bounded 512-record synthetic inventory with duplicates, mixed visibility and containers
scenario_contracts.expected_authoritative_outcome: read operations remain deterministic over authorized projection; scale count creates no capacity promise

scenario_contracts.title: 512-record inventory nonvisual navigation
scenario_contracts.material_differential: same bounded inventory through keyboard/screen-reader semantic path
scenario_contracts.expected_authoritative_outcome: same authorized semantic task outcome as visual path

scenario_contracts.title: 128-record dense Creature/NPC targeting
scenario_contracts.material_differential: bounded dense target set with repeated names and mixed visibility
scenario_contracts.expected_authoritative_outcome: stable-ID target identity and permission-safe counts; no balance certification

scenario_contracts.title: Dense encounter semantic nonvisual targeting
scenario_contracts.material_differential: dense target set remains complete without map/spatial cues
scenario_contracts.expected_authoritative_outcome: same authorized target semantics as permitted visual path; uncertainty remains PPIA-11 bounded

scenario_contracts.title: Unusual nonhuman morphology inspection
scenario_contracts.material_differential: synthetic radial six-limbed form omits human-corresponding fields
scenario_contracts.expected_authoritative_outcome: known morphology remains semantic; unspecified anatomy/compatibility remains unknown

scenario_contracts.title: Phone-only unusual morphology flow
scenario_contracts.material_differential: compact touch-only morphology inspection avoids spatial body-map dependence
scenario_contracts.expected_authoritative_outcome: all governed fields remain reachable; unsupported fields remain unknown

scenario_contracts.title: Phone-only single-focus conflict review
scenario_contracts.material_differential: current and stale intents are reviewed sequentially rather than in desktop parallel panes
scenario_contracts.operation: inspect current version and own stale intent; choose only owning-domain allowed resolution
scenario_contracts.expected_authoritative_outcome: no forced overwrite due to hidden second pane

scenario_contracts.title: Keyboard-only conflict recovery
scenario_contracts.material_differential: awkward version/status conflict rather than basic keyboard smoke path
scenario_contracts.expected_authoritative_outcome: complete keyboard path preserves persistent semantic conflict/status information

scenario_contracts.title: Bounded offline read-only source browse
scenario_contracts.material_differential: authorized cached Definition browse is available while authoritative mutation is unavailable
scenario_contracts.expected_authoritative_outcome: no canonical mutation, reveal expansion, instance creation or fabricated Event
forbidden_outcomes: stale cache presented as fresh authority

scenario_contracts.title: Offline cached protected data revoked before reconnect
scenario_contracts.material_differential: server-side authority changes while client is offline with cached protected data
scenario_contracts.operation: reauthorize before cached protected data reuse
scenario_contracts.expected_authoritative_outcome: current authority is resolved first and unauthorized derivatives are purged

protected_nonclone_baseline.rule: Ordinary GM modification remains inherited coverage. Only composed scenario P15-SCN-005 is additive because stale-version conflict changes the safe oracle.

source_gap_guard.rule: No install, activate, update, remove, promotion or Pack lifecycle semantics are invented.
